# Tumbite

> Tumbite is a food delivery app by Windoce LLC (Florida, United States). It connects customers, local restaurants, and drivers: restaurants pay a 7.5% to 15% commission depending on their plan, with no lock-in contracts; drivers keep 100% of the tip and see what they earn before accepting; customers see the full breakdown before paying and follow their order live. Every paid order is watched by an automatic Manager that reminds the restaurant and refunds the customer if nobody confirms within 10 minutes. It starts in Miami and opens city by city, in any country, with local franchises that fund the launch (a fleet of motorbikes, training, a tablet for every restaurant, and finding the first customers). The app is bilingual (English and Spanish). Contact: support@tumbite.com · franchises: sales@tumbite.com.

## Guides (Docs)

- [Docs · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs): Short guides for ordering, for restaurants, for drivers, and for the teams that open each city.
- [How do I…? · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/how-to): The questions we get asked most, each with a step-by-step guide and real screenshots.
- [Ordering · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering): ⌘K← Docs OrderingChoose size and extras when orderingIf an item has options, when you add it you choose the size, extras or whatever the restaurant offers,
- [Choose size and extras when ordering · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/choose-options): If an item has options, when you add it you choose the size, extras or whatever the restaurant offers, and see what each adds.
- [If the restaurant is out of an item in your order · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/out-of-stock-item): Nothing gets canceled outright: you decide whether to remove it (we refund that part) or cancel the whole order.
- [Leave at door or hand it to me: you choose · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/door-or-hand): When you order, you say whether to leave it at your door or hand it to you. The driver sees it and acts accordingly.
- [Chat with your driver · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/chat-with-your-driver): From the moment your order has a driver until it arrives, you can message them from the app, without sharing your number.
- [When your order arrives: the estimate and the latest arrival time · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/when-will-it-arrive): You see two times: in how many minutes it arrives and the latest arrival time. And we tell you when the driver is a minute away and at your door.
- [How to place your first order · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/first-order): Pick a nearby restaurant, build your cart, and pay with a card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay.
- [Track your order live · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/track-order): Confirmed, in the kitchen, on the way, and delivered, with your driver on the map.
- [Cancel an order and get your money back · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/cancel-order): Until the restaurant accepts it, you cancel in one tap and get a full refund. And if the restaurant doesn’t answer, we cancel it for you.
- [My account: your orders, cards, and details · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/my-account): All your orders and their status, the cards you saved, and your details, in one place in the app.
- [Gifts: birthday, punch card, and win-back · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/rewards): Restaurants reward you for coming back. Gifts show up in your cart on their own.
- [Rate the food and the driver · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/rate): Two separate ratings. If the food was late, it’s not the driver’s fault.

- [Ready to open: what you need before taking orders · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/activation-checklist): Before turning on “Taking orders,” your restaurant needs a phone number, an address with a pin, hours, and at least one dish with a price. The checklist te
- [Your hours: open and close on their own · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/hours): Set your shifts per day and Tumbite opens and closes your restaurant at those times. Outside of them customers see when you open.
- [Item options: size, extras, no onions · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/item-options): Each item can have option groups: the customer chooses when ordering and the price adds up automatically.
- [If you’re out of an item or need more time · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/out-of-stock-and-more-time): Flag the item you’re out of and the customer decides in their app; and if you’re running late, add minutes before the driver leaves.
- [Your counter: see the driver coming, the QR code and the wait · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/your-counter): On your screen you see who’s coming for each order, how many minutes away they are, when they arrived and how long they wait. Next to each ready order ther
- [Put your restaurant on Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/get-started): Create your account, complete your profile, and wait for approval. No lock-in contracts.
- [Your menu: items, prices, and photos · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/menu): Every item in English and Spanish, with its price, category, and photo.
- [Mark an item as sold out · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/sold-out): Out of chicken? Turn it off for today in one tap and nobody can order it.
- [Receiving orders and the alarm · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/orders): It rings loud until someone accepts. No order gets forgotten at rush hour.
- [Your dashboard: how your restaurant is doing · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/dashboard): Orders, sales, your payout, best sellers, your real kitchen time, and what customers think, at a glance.
- [Verify your restaurant · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/verify): Four photos from your phone: your ID, your face, and your storefront. That’s how your customers know you’re real.
- [Gifts and marketing · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/gifts): Set aside a share of your sales to reward loyal customers.
- [Daily summary and your wallet · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/earnings): Orders, sales, commission, and your payout. Cash out to your bank.
- [For drivers · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers): ⌘K← Docs For driversWhen an offer reaches you and how you pick up with the codeOffers reach you so you arrive when the food is ready, not before. At the re
- [When an offer reaches you and how you pick up with the code · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers/offer-timing-and-pickup-code): Offers reach you so you arrive when the food is ready, not before. At the restaurant you scan the code on their screen and take the photo: the order goes o
- [If you can’t continue with an order or the customer isn’t there · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers/cant-continue): Before pickup you can release the order with a reason, no penalty. At the door, if the customer isn’t there, there’s a 5-minute protocol.
- [Start delivering · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers/get-started): Create your account, go online when you want, and accept only what works for you.
- [Verify your identity · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers/verify): Your ID and a photo of your face, right from the app. It’s what gives customers peace of mind when they open the door.
- [Offers: see what you earn before you accept · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers/offers): You see the pay, the distance, and the pickup spot. Declining never counts against you.
- [Levels: Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Diamond · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers/levels): Higher levels see bigger orders first. You level up with deliveries and good ratings.
- [Your wallet: what you earn and how you cash out · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers/wallet): Like a banking app: your balance, earnings, tips, and every movement with its order. Cash out to your bank whenever you want.
- [How we look after every order · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust): ⌘K← Docs How we look after every orderIf you lose signal when deliveringThe delivery photo (or “Handed to the customer”) is saved on your phone and sent on
- [If you lose signal when delivering · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust/no-signal-delivery): The delivery photo (or “Handed to the customer”) is saved on your phone and sent on its own when the signal is back. Don’t redo it.
- [How we know you reached the door (and what to do if GPS fails) · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust/gps-arrival): The deliver button appears once GPS confirms you’re at the address. If a building or garage throws it off, request the exception and support authorizes you
- [Photo at pickup, delivery at the door · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust/pickup-and-delivery-photos): Every order leaves two photos: the closed order as it leaves the restaurant, confirmed by the restaurant, and the delivery at the door.
- [An order from start to finish · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust/order-journey): What happens from the moment the customer pays until the food reaches the door, who does what at each step, and how the money is split.
- [The Manager: no order gets forgotten · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust/manager): An automatic watcher follows every order from payment to the door, and steps in only when something runs late.
- [The traffic light on every order · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust/traffic-light): Green, yellow, or red: at a glance you know which order is fine and which one needs attention.
- [Verified restaurants and drivers · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust/verification): Every restaurant is a real business and every driver is who they say they are. A person on our team checks it.
- [Tumbite compared with other delivery apps](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust/compare): How much each app keeps from the restaurant, what the customer pays, and what the driver gets. With public numbers, so everyone can decide.
- [For entrepreneurs · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/business): ⌘K← Docs For entrepreneursCalculator: how much you earn and save with TumbiteA calculator for everyone: the restaurant, the driver, the customer, and whoev
- [Calculator: how much you earn and save with Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/business/calculator): A calculator for everyone: the restaurant, the driver, the customer, and whoever wants to open Tumbite in their city.
- [Franchises: bring Tumbite to your city](https://tumbite.com/docs/business/franchises): Every new city opens with a local partner. What you pay for isn’t a brand: it’s a complete launch, with a fleet, training, tablets, and the first customers
- [Launch team training · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/business/team-training): The reading list for everyone on the team that opens a city: what to read, in what order, and what they should be able to explain at the end.
- [Your account · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/account): ⌘K← Docs Your accountCreate your accountOne account to order, one for your restaurant, and one to deliver. Each takes a minute.Forgot my passwordWe email y
- [Create your account · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/account/create-account): One account to order, one for your restaurant, and one to deliver. Each takes a minute.
- [Forgot my password · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/account/password): We email you a link. It works once and expires in 30 minutes.
- [Confirm your email · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/account/confirm-email): When you sign up, you get a link to confirm the email is yours.
- [Delete your account · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/account/delete): From the account menu, in the three dots. Your personal data is removed.
- [Help from a real person, with your own link · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/account/support): Report a problem from the app or write to us: every case gets its own private conversation, and we email you every time we reply.
